excerpts: The official site of Walt Disney Animation Studios. Walt Disney Animation Studios is a filmmaker-driven animation studio responsible for creating some of the most beloved films ever made. Located in California, Disney Animation continues to build on its rich legacy of innovation and creativity, from the first fully-animated feature film– 1937's Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs– to 2026's Hexed.
